description: Lists a site's top-level sections in order - each one's CURRENT index, its stable section_id, its kind, its heading, and its fields (every editable node inside it: heading, body, items[n].title, ... with each node's index and current text) - so you can aim edit_section at exactly the right node with section_id + field. Indices shift whenever an earlier section is removed, so list the sections again after any removal instead of reusing an index you recorded earlier. section_count here is the number of top-level sections listed (the same number as listed_section_count in add_section / edit_section results; their section_count counts every node in the tree). Free, and no account is needed for a draft you created.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

page.description: Which page of the site, as its path ("/about", "/contact"). Omit for the home page. See list_pages.

site_key.description: The site to list. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

stage.description: true = work on a staged copy instead of the live site: preview it at staged_preview_url, then publish_staged or discard_staged. Omit for a normal (immediately live) edit.

name: list_sections
title: List a site's sections
